cohort: 686 preterm neonates admitted to Felege Hiwot Specialized Hospital between August 1, 2017, and July 30, 2018.
finding: Respiratory distress syndrome, necrotizing enterocolitis, asphyxia, hospital-acquired infection, birth weight, gestational age, and place of delivery were significantly associated with time to death in preterm neonates.
birth_weight: Not specified, but birth weight was an exposure variable.
